rationale: The record shows the agent executed multiple write actions (modifying a pending order’s shipping address, changing the user’s default address, and attempting an item exchange) without any explicit confirmation from the user beforehand. This violates the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the agent appears to have used both exchange_delivered_order_items and modify_pending_order_items on the same order (#W1603792), which is inconsistent because an order cannot be both delivered and pending. It is unclear whether the agent properly authenticated the user beyond email lookup, and there is no clear evidence they verified which order was misaddressed before making changes. These issues indicate noncompliance with the policy and likely incorrect execution of the requested changes.
